verdict.rationale: A visual infrastructure canvas is a fair capability for a serverless or deployment platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no canvas for visualizing or editing the stack. Workers is managed through Wrangler CLI commands, bindings defined in code, and dashboard actions such as rollbacks, none of which amount to a visual canvas editor.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can visualize and edit my entire infrastructure stack on a visual canvas without writing config files
